content: Firefox ExtensionSettings policy maps extension ID to config: installation_mode allowed/blocked/force_installed/normal_installed; force_installed and normal_installed require install_url (FF153+: optional for AMO-hosted, resolves latest by ID); install_url accepts https XPI or file:/// for local filesystem; file ships inside policies.policies.ExtensionSettings in distribution/policies.json (cross-platform; Linux also /etc/firefox/policies).
